Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land

Date: 28th October 2026
Topic: Brain Health – Awareness and Healthy Living
Guest Speaker: Dr. Ashutosh Shah

The Rotary Club of Mumbai Downtown Sea Land successfully conducted its weekly meeting on 28th October 2026, featuring an informative and enlightening session on “Brain Health” by distinguished guest speaker Dr. Ashutosh Shah.

During his insightful presentation, Dr. Shah shared valuable information about the importance of maintaining good brain health, memory, mental well-being, healthy lifestyle habits, and preventive care.

All Rotarians listened with great interest and thoroughly enjoyed the informative session. The lecture created awareness about the importance of keeping our brains healthy and active, particularly as we grow older.

The session was highly appreciated by all members and proved to be an excellent learning experience.

Special Thanks and Appreciation
